listing.name: Keyboard As Mouse - An Accessibility(?) Mod
listing.summary: This mod is built on a sort of library I'm referring to as True Input Faker, which it uses to generate fake mouse events (and possibly fake keyboard events in the future) by injecting itself between Starsector and the LWJGL game library it's built on.
listing.aiSummary: Allows controlling the in-game mouse cursor and performing clicks, scrolling, and dragging using only the keyboard.

description: Injects itself between Starsector and LWJGL to generate fake mouse events. Enables full control of the in-game cursor via keyboard inputs for left clicks, right clicks, movement, scrolling, and click-and-hold actions.
